semiconductor_relevance: Medium — FMTK Co., Ltd. acts as a distributor for several companies providing equipment and systems relevant to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: FMTK Co., Ltd. is a distributor in Korea for several key players in the semiconductor equipment market, including Graco, K-Patents, Futurestar Corporation, and White Knight Fluid Handling. They offer a range of products including pumps, flow monitoring systems, and concentration measuring equipment that support semiconductor fabrication processes.
capabilities: Hose Pumps and Diaphragm Pumps from Graco
Concentration Meters for Chemical & Slurry from K-Patents
Flowmeters and Flow Control Systems from Futurestar Corporation
High Purity PTFE Bellows Pumps from White Knight Fluid Handling

regional_presence.Korea: FMTK Co., Ltd. operates as a distributor for multiple international companies within the semiconductor sector in Korea.
